name: @ali/worker
description: Cloudflare Worker for architect.alikorea-demo.com: email-and-password accounts with emailed codes, admin approval, the SPA from static assets and POST /api/turn

scripts.d1:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply alichitect --local --env dev
scripts.d1:unlock:remote: wrangler d1 execute alichitect --remote --env="" --command "DELETE FROM lockouts; DELETE FROM rate; DELETE FROM codes; DELETE FROM signups"
scripts.d1:unlock:local: wrangler d1 execute alichitect --local --env dev --command "DELETE FROM lockouts; DELETE FROM rate; DELETE FROM codes; DELETE FROM signups"
